prompt: I need to create an Angular 21 app initializer that loads remote feature flags from /api/config before the app starts rendering. The config should be available as an InjectionToken throughout the app. Also show me how to add an environment initializer that sets up a logging service when a lazy-loaded route module bootstraps. Use the modern Angular APIs, not the deprecated APP_INITIALIZER token.
assertions: Uses provideAppInitializer() function from @angular/core (not the APP_INITIALIZER multi token)
Creates an InjectionToken for the feature flags config
The app initializer returns a Promise or Observable (async initialization)
Uses inject() inside the initializer to access HttpClient or other services
Uses provideEnvironmentInitializer() for the lazy-loaded route setup
The config token is injectable throughout the app after initialization
